requalifications.m: More than one requalification. requalification: the act of qualifying again.

requalified.m: Past tense of requalify. requalify: to qualify again.

requalifies.m: A form of requalify, as in “she requalifies”. requalify: to qualify again.

requalifying.m: The -ing form of requalify. requalify: to qualify again.

requestor.m: One who, or that which, makes a request.

requestors.m: More than one requestor. requestor: one who, or that which, makes a request.

requirers.m: More than one requirer. requirer: a person who requires.

requisitioner.m: One who, or that which, requisitions.

requiters.m: More than one requiter. requiter: one who requites.
